title: Point at a color and its value joins the spec
goal: A spec hand-off usually carries colors as well as sizes, and Figma and Sketch show an element color beside its dimensions. Photonz cannot read a color off the picture. A Color mode in the Measure tool would let you click a spot and get a small swatch pill with the hex value, listed with the measurements and included in the spec list.
notes: Blocked on the decision opened by the 2026-09-02 manager pass: the user has said speculative features get confirmed before they are built. Sampling reads the composited base image through ImageStore in PhotonzRender; the readout can reuse the measure pill (PillRasterizer) and MeasureSpecList.specLine gains a color case. Open thread since the 2026-09-01 manager pass (Figma and Sketch parity).
acceptance: With a new next-measure-color flag on in the Next release: pick Measure, choose Color, hover and a swatch pill follows the pointer with the hex value of the pixel under it; click and the swatch lands as a measurement row named by its value.
The spec list carries a line per color swatch in the same format as measurements, with the role word color.
Option-click samples the average of a small area instead of one pixel, so anti-aliased text does not mislead.
Core logic (sampling, naming, spec line) lives in PhotonzCore with tests first; Scripts/test.sh green; audit written under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task.

Nothing reads answer.choice to tell an approval from a decline, so a declined task re-enters the queue looking approved. Filed as a follow-up.

Also on the merits: colour sampling serves spec hand-off, but the user chose to redline real captures with Size and Gap first and see what is actually missing. Shottr and CleanShot X ship no colour readout; only Figma/Sketch inspect do, and those read design tokens, not rendered pixels. Speculative until the measure tools have been used in anger.
Dropped without code changes. The card can be reopened by a future manager pass once Size and Gap have real mileage.
